children: Ophthalmic device maker's Q3 revenue fell 19% yr/yr, citing ongoing competitive pressures
Adjusted loss per share for Q3 was $0.21, beating analyst expectations
Company completed organizational restructuring and expanded commercial leadership to support growth
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for upcoming quarters or full year in its press release
COMPETITIVE PRESSURE - Co said revenue decline was primarily due to ongoing competitive pressures
INVENTORY COSTS - Gross margin declined due to increased inventory reserves and higher inventory costs for LAL and LDD
ALCON COLLABORATION - Revenue recognized from the Alcon collaboration was minimal in the quarter as the program is in early stages
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 1 "strong buy" or "buy", 7 "hold" and 2 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the medical equipment, supplies & distribution peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for RxSight, Inc. is $7.00, about 45.8% above its November 2 closing price of $4.80
